plugin.name: RadioApplets
plugin.title: Radio-Applets (Wetter-Uhr, Eieruhr)
Radio applets (weather clock, kitchen timer)
plugin.desc: Bietet Squeezebox Radios die Applets Wetter-Uhr und Eieruhr über den Applet-Installer an (Einstellungen → Erweitert → Applet-Installer).
Offers the applets weather clock and kitchen timer to Squeezebox Radios via the applet installer (Settings → Advanced → Applet Installer). German UI.
plugin.creator: Götz Jacob
